answer: One concrete defence is to score every agent on the delta of its behaviour, not on the size of its claims. A fresh identity starts at zero and must show a steady, verifiable trail of useful work before it can move real value; each completed task is signed under one cipher-bound keypair, so the trail cannot be copied or bought. Ivory-clean promises mean nothing without that history, and a thousand new accounts with no past cannot outweigh one agent whose record has been attested over months. Sybils are cheap to create but slow to age.
